# External ImGui menus

The `basic-mod`, `simple-mod`, and `advanced-mod` directories implement the Dear ImGui (Direct3D 7) external mod menus (`D3D7Imgui` backend) with the same menu items and native actions as `demos/internal/`.

- `basic-mod` (`igi_basic_mod_menu_external` -> `igi-basic-mod-external.dll`)
- `simple-mod` (`igi_simple_mod_menu_external` -> `igi-simple-mod-external.dll`)
- `advanced-mod` (`igi_advanced_mod_menu_external` -> `igi-advanced-mod-external.dll`)
